Subject: Quick recap + next steps from today's discovery

Hi Samir —

Great to meet today — thanks for walking us through WellnessAI's ingestion pipeline and the 2 primary workloads you mentioned (real-time chat summarization and nightly embedding jobs). Quick recap and asks so we can assess procurement path: 

- Procurement route: you mentioned finance prefers a PO for platform purchases but some teams use corporate card for pilots. Can you confirm which path you'd prefer for an initial paid pilot (~$10k/mo usage)?
- Security/compliance: you asked for SOC 2 evidence and our DPA — I'll start that process.
- Marketplace: you asked whether Redwood is available via AWS Marketplace and what the billing flow would look like.

Next steps I propose:
1) You share any internal procurement form / PO requirements (fields, signoff approvers).
2) We provide SOC 2 snapshot + our standard DPA and an options doc outlining PO vs card vs marketplace (impact to invoicing & timing).
3) Rafael will scope the commercial options (short SOW or marketplace listing).

I'm attaching a short product one-pager for the team. If PO is the route, please share the procurement contact and any required legal/routing info.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Marissa

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the summary. A few clarifications from our side after syncing with finance: 

- Procurement preference: For anything >$5k/month finance wants a standard PO (they have a preferred template). For pilot-level spend under that, we can usually use card. For the initial pilot you suggested (~$10k/mo) we'll need PO routing.
- Timeline: PO approvals typically take 2–3 weeks with our procurement approvers (I can expedite if needed).
- Security: SOC 2 and DPA are required before vendor onboarding. We also have a short security questionnaire that may ask about data residency and audit logs.
- Marketplace: AWS Marketplace would be ideal if we can get consolidated billing, but our procurement team is conservative — they'd still require a PO in many cases unless Marketplace passes through as AWS invoice.

I've attached our procurement requirements sheet so you can see the fields procurement will expect. I can introduce your billing/legal contact to our procurement lead if you want to move forward.

Samir
Head of Platform
WellnessAI
